Dock-flash gradient — the white radial bloom painted at the figure's center for the last quarter of the run (the reference's suck punctuation). Built once in the ctor: the figure rect never moves mid-session, and a per-frame createRadialGradient would violate the zero-allocation frame budget. Null when the ctx lacks gradient support — the flash is decorative, never load-bearing.

(module scope)

Strip-boundary scratch — the field evaluated at each strip edge (STRIPS+1 boundaries): viewport-space y, left-corner x and right-corner x. Neighbouring bands share a boundary corner, so the parallelogram quads stay airtight along the funnel's S-walls; allocating per frame would violate the zero-allocation frame budget.

(module scope)

Draws the sheet as STRIPS horizontal bands under the genie field — the per-row staggered eased lerp the ui-layouts mac-genie reference implements. The field always warps the MODAL rect (S) toward the FIGURE rect (D) — on open S=to/D=from, on close S=from/D=to; p arrives already flipped (see genie.ts).

Strip math (viewport CSS px — the ctx transform maps to device px): rows index in "down-space" — ty runs 0 at the sheet's far edge to 1 at the figure-facing edge — and each row owns two staggered clocks: xs = (1−ty)·STAGGER_X xe = easeInOutCubic(clamp((p−xs)/(1−xs))) ys = (1−ty)·STAGGER_Y ye = easeInQuad( clamp((p−ys)/(1−ys))) The leading edge's rows start at p=0 while the far edge waits out its stagger — the funnel's S-walls and the "window flows through the neck" look emerge from the stagger alone (no sine bow, no shear term). Each row lands on its proportional row inside the card rect at p=1 — the canonical point-collapse mouth suits a dock icon, not a half-viewport card. Rows stay horizontal (y depends only on ty), so bands tile exactly — the shared boundary corners keep neighbouring parallelograms airtight through the funnel.

  • @param p Eased funnel progress 0..1 (0 = modal, 1 = figure).

dispose

Removes the overlay canvas — the sheet ctx dies with the session.
